Data from USDA National Nutrient Database for Standard Reference (2011).

Note that you need to eat a generous portion (more calories) of beans
and other forms of plant protein to equal the protein in animal foods.
Most fruits and vegetables contain only small amounts of protein, which
may contribute a total of 5 to 10 grams of protein per day, depending on
how much you eat. Butter, margarine, oil, sugar, soda, alcohol, and coffee
contain no protein, and most desserts contain very little.
